name: TP ICAP Group PLC
summary: TP ICAP Group PLC provides intermediary services, contextual insights, trade execution, pre-trade and settlement services, and data-led solutions in Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Americas, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through Global Broking, Energy & Commodities, Liquidnet, and Parameta Solutions divisions. The Global Broking division operates in rates, foreign exchange (FX) and money markets, equities, and credit products; and offers broking, facilitating price discovery, and liquidity services.
